name: Maureen Jensen
role: Head of the dockside syndicate; the dock gate and the men at it
temper_why: never asks, gives and counts, owes nobody; never the police (CAST)
sched: by car: the office over the net store

lines.shared: authored scenes and live talk only (a rival head: the bank's no_kind)

card.who: Maureen Jensen, 57, the Widow: runs the dockside syndicate from the office over the net store. Taxes the cabs at the dock gate. Has not walked up Quay Street in years.
card.speak: Low, slow, never asks. Calls men Mister until she owns them, then by their first name.
card.life: A house at the top of Cold Store Road. The net store office by day; home by six.
card.rivals: Wants the dock gate and the men at it; fears a gate with nobody at it.
